evidence.observation: Pressure held at ~2.97-3.00 Torr through the ramp, then rose steadily during growth: 3.00 → 3.05 → 3.10 → 3.13 → 3.15 Torr
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm (setpoint), so the flow did not change to cause the pressure rise
Temperature held at the 750 °C setpoint with normal heater power
No exhaust O2 sensor installed, so a leak can't be told apart from an exhaust blockage

args.missing_evidence: Pressure readings from normal runs at this stage (none provided), plus a test that separates the causes: a leak-up test with flow stopped and the tube isolated, a check of exhaust conductance or pump behaviour, or an O2/air measurement.
